demos.question: According to the product policy, what is the return window in days for non-perishables? Return an integer.
Which employee handled the most orders all-time? Return {employee:str, orders:int} using the employee's last name.
demos.sql: SELECT e.LastName, COUNT(*) n FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID=o.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
